shortDescription: Find truck capacity, share availability and follow private shipment updates.
fullDescription:
Find transport and stay connected with your shipment.

Loadgistic connects fleets and independent drivers with brokers, shippers and receivers through truck capacity sharing and private shipment tracking.

FIND AVAILABLE TRUCKS
Explore public capacity without an account. Search transporter profiles, filter trucks by the space and route you need, and see their approximate location and service areas. Confirm availability and the transport details directly with the provider.

SHARE YOUR CAPACITY
Publish available space to the open market, share it with named contacts, or do both. Approved contacts can verify their email to see the signals shared with them. Independent drivers manage one current truck; transport companies manage their trucks and drivers.

FOLLOW AGREED SHIPMENTS
Keep authorized shipment partners informed with status updates, loading and unloading photos, and approximate location. The shipment owner can approve unloading from their private tracking page.

GET HELP ARRANGING TRANSPORT
Tell Loadgistic's transport team what you need and continue the conversation in live chat.

USE THE LANGUAGE THAT SUITS YOU
The app supports English, Amharic, Afaan Oromo, Somali and Tigrinya.

Location sharing requires your consent and Android permissions. During agreed active tracking, background updates can continue while the app is closed until unloading is approved. Shared locations are approximate. Notifications are optional.

Document badges identify the specific documents Loadgistic has reviewed. They help you assess providers; they are not a service guarantee. Loadgistic does not handle in-app transport payments.
